title: Quantization-quality-adapter-and-differential-metrics-pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement a modular 'quality adapter' and differential metrics pipeline to produce task-aligned accuracy signals for FP8/INT8 quantized profiles during calibration and validation. The adapter must compare quantized outputs against float baselines and emit metric bundles usable by the calibration orchestrator and the Console quality dashboards. Core metric families: perplexity and next-token logprob aggregates for LM-style tests, MMLU-style multi-choice accuracy + confidence calibration, Rouge/BLEU for summarization/translation, and extensible task-specific scorers (token-level F1, code execution pass/fail, semantic similarity). Requirements: deterministic evaluation harness, batched scoring compatible with our eval cluster, per-profile and per-sample diffs, metric-level thresholds for rollout gating, and compact JSON contracts for downstream ingestion. Must be pluggable so new scorers can be registered without changing infrastructure code. Integrate with the calibration workflow to mark a profile as "quality-regressed" if thresholds fail, and emit per-run artifacts (scorer logs, sampled failures, model-output diffs) to S3/Drive links for engineering review.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter library provides a stable Python interface for registering scorers and running batched evaluations (API documented)
Support built-in scorers: perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy, Rouge-L, BLEU, token-F1, and a pass/fail executor wrapper for code tasks
Produces deterministic JSON metric bundles with per-task breakdowns and float-vs-quant diffs
Integrates with calibration pipeline to apply metric-based gates and produce human-readable failure samples
End-to-end benchmark: run on sample calibration dataset for 7 models (2 fp32 baselines + 5 quant profiles) within 6 hours on eval cluster
Automated unit/integration tests covering scorer outputs, seeding determinism, and threshold gating
Console ingestion: metrics map to pre-defined dashboard widgets and can be sliced by profile and model version
tasks: Design scorer interface and JSON contract (proto for downstream teams)
Implement core scorers: perplexity, mmlu_adapter, rouge_l, bleu, token_f1
Add scorer harness for batched evaluation with deterministic RNG seeding
Produce quant-vs-float diff exporter and sample failing cases
Hook into calibration orchestrator to consume metric bundles and enforce rollout policies
Create CI tests and synthetic data fixtures for all scorers
Add end-to-end job on eval cluster and validate runtime/IO bounds
Document API, examples, and onboarding guide for PM/DS/Console teams
